# Thanksgiving Hymns Column 20 — The EMET Bible (Literal)
**Translator:** EMET | **Source:** 1QHa (Cave 1), Col. 20 | **Condition:** heavily damaged/fragmentary

---

**20:1** [...] You have opened [...] my heart [...] to Your instruction [...]

**20:2** [...] and I have listened to Your truth [...] and You have [...] my ear [...]

**20:3** [...] the mysteries of Your wonder You have revealed to me [...]

**20:4** [...] and understanding [...] Your holy spirit [...]

**20:5** [...] You have opened a fountain of knowledge for all who have understanding,

**20:6** and a wellspring of might for all who are perfect of way, and a source [...]

**20:7** [...] and they drink [...] from the spirit of holiness [...] for the glory of [...]

**20:8** [...] with all the appointed times of eternity and the seasons [...]

**20:9** [...] You have set before me [...] truth and righteousness [...]

**20:10** [...] and covenant-faithfulness to save me and compassion [...]

**20:11** [...] understanding [...] the mysteries of Your wonder [...] and who [...]

**20:12** [...] and who is the creature of clay before You? And what is he [...]

**20:13** [...] You have engraved the law upon my heart and [...] understanding [...]

**20:14** [...] and a spirit of knowledge in all works of truth [...]

**20:15** [...] to walk humbly [...] and to love covenant-faithfulness [...]

**20:16** [...] and a contrite heart [...] the spirit of holiness [...]

**20:17** [...] You have strengthened [...] and my steps in the paths of righteousness [...]

**20:18** [...] upon the level ground [...] and to walk before You in the border of [...]

**20:19** [...] the way of life [...] and the path of peace without end [...]

**20:20** [...] and who is the creature of clay before [...] You have engraved [...]

**20:21** [...] upon the tablets of [...] the instruction of life [...]

**20:22** [...] You have appointed for me [...] truth [...]

**20:23** [...] the judgments of [...] and to walk in all [...]

**20:24** [...] and not to turn aside from any of Your words [...]

**20:25** [...] a spirit of knowledge [...] truth and righteousness [...]

**20:26** [...] the holy spirit upon Your servant [...]

**20:27** [...] to stand [...] in Your presence forever [...]

**20:28** [...] for You have taught me [...] the purpose of Your heart [...]

**20:29** [...] and in Your truth You have [...] sustained me [...]

**20:30** [...] and Your covenant-faithfulness [...] is my delight [...]

**20:31** [...] forgiveness and abundance of mercies [...] in Your righteous judgment [...]

**20:32** [...] a spirit of knowledge [...] truth and righteousness [...] the holy spirit [...]

**20:33** [...] You have fashioned [...] and in Your truth [...]

**20:34** [...] the works of Your hands [...] for Your glory [...]

**20:35** [...] and all their host [...] the spirits of [...]

**20:36** [...] and the holy ones [...] and the eternal ones [...] in jubilation [...]

**20:37** [...] before You [...] forever and ever [...].

---
*EMET notes: Column 20 is very heavily damaged with only partial phrases surviving. The text speaks of divine instruction, the holy spirit upon the servant, walking in truth and righteousness, and the engraving of law upon the heart (echoing Jeremiah 31:33). "Covenant-faithfulness" (hesed) appears at least twice.*
